findings.label: Font-size reductions outside stated scope
findings.description: src/index.css reduces font-size on ~18 selectors by ~10% each (footer links, hero stats, fan-deck card values, roadmap card titles, FAQ orbit text, coin-reveal heading, etc.). The result summary does not mention these changes, and the coder's stated constraint was 'no colors, fonts, animations, or visual design were changed.' The reductions are uniform (~10%) and appear intentional — components built from fixed px/rem values need text to shrink proportionally. The team should confirm this is acceptable or narrow the constraint to 'no typeface, weight, or color changes.'
